question: Who is the author of the Indian national anthem?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rabindranath Tagore**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rabindranath Tagore** is the author of the Indian national anthem, "Jana Gana Mana".
 
• The anthem was originally composed in Bengali and was later translated into Hindi.
 
• Rabindranath Tagore was a renowned poet, writer, and the first non-European to win the Nobel Prize in Literature in 1913.
 
• "Jana Gana Mana" was adopted as the national anthem of India on January 24, 1950.
 
• The anthem reflects the unity and diversity of India, embodying the country's rich cultural heritage.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Rabindranath Tagore** was born on May 7, 1861, in Calcutta (now Kolkata), India.
 
• He was a polymath who contributed to various fields such as literature, music, and art.
 
• Tagore founded the Visva-Bharati University in Santiniketan, which remains a prominent educational institution.
 
• He was also known for his role in the Indian independence movement, although he was more of a cultural and spiritual leader than a political one.
 
• Tagore's works include the famous collection of poems "Gitanjali" for which he received the Nobel Prize.
 
• In addition to "Jana Gana Mana", he also composed the national anthem of Bangladesh, "Amar Shonar Bangla".
